monospace.usage: SKUs, QR Codes, Data Tables, Inventory Quantities

rules: NO Inter, Roboto, or Open Sans for headings.
Headings (H1) max text-4xl to text-5xl on desktop, tight letter spacing.
Overlines/Labels MUST be uppercase, tiny, wide spacing (tracking-[0.2em]).
Hierarchy Gap Rule: Ensure contrast in font size between title and subtitle.
Borders must be high contrast (e.g., border-gray-200 or border-gray-300) to expose the skeleton.
FORBIDDEN COLOR: teal green or teal blue (#1B93A4).
Never use pure black or pure grey. Tint greys with subtle cool blue/purple.
High contrast for all text to meet APCA standards. ALWAYS explicitly set text color on hover.

surfaces_and_borders.border_radius: rounded-sm (2px max for slight softening) or cardless
surfaces_and_borders.shadows: Minimal to none. Rely on 1px solid borders for definition rather than soft shadows.
rules: DO NOT use transparent backgrounds for headers/dropdowns. Always solid white or heavy glassmorphism with 1px inner stroke.
Dashboard cards: Flat background, 1px subtle border, no shadow by default. On hover: slight lift, subtle shadow.
Containers with border must have padding on text content to avoid collision.

layouts_and_spacing.dashboard_grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 with tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6).
rules: Mobile-first responsive layout.
Sidebar layout: fixed left sidebar (w-64 on desktop, collapsible), main content area on the right.
Direct Children Only for grids. Do not wrap grid items in random divs.
Left-align tabular data, forms, and paragraphs for better readability.

motion.hover_states: Crisp transitions. Border color darkens, slight lift (-translate-y-1) for interactive cards.
rules: Do NOT use 'transition: all'. Apply specific transitions (e.g., transition-colors, transition-transform).
Use sonner for toast notifications (top-right placement).

navigation.content: Dashboard, Inventori, Surat Jalan, Penerimaan, Master Data (Warehouses, Brands, Categories), Profil

data_table.features: Photo thumbnails (zoom in tight on product), brand colored dots/chips, robust filtering (warehouse, brand, category), search, export to Excel button.
data_table.style: Dense tabular layout, sticky header, compact rows, 1px solid borders between rows.

kpi_cards.style: Metric-focused, top-left priority. Show Jenis Barang, Tersedia, Keluar, Total Unit, Gudang, Rusak, Hilang, Terpakai, SJ Aktif, SJ Selesai.

surat_jalan.features: Tabs for Aktif / Selesai. Detail view with on-screen QR code. Print to PDF. Return flow with states (Baik/Rusak/Hilang/Terpakai).

master_data.features: CRUD for Warehouses, Brands, Categories. Brand requires a COLOR PICKER using the 11-color brand_palette.

rules: All interactive elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., data-testid='sidebar-inventory-link').
Focus states must have higher contrast (e.g., focus:ring-2 focus:ring-brand/50).
Animations should respect prefers-reduced-motion.

images.description: Stage lights illuminate a dark venue with warm glow (Use for Lighting Category thumbnails)
Spotlight on a tripod (Use for Lighting Category thumbnails)
Detailed view of colorful dials on an audio mixing console (Use for Sound Category thumbnails)
Large warehouse filled with lots of shelves (Use for login background or empty states)

rules: NEVER use placeholder URLs. Use provided images for product thumbnails or avatars.
Zoom in: Use close-ups for item thumbnails to create intimacy.

instructions_to_main_agent: Initialize Shadcn UI and customize component borders to be sharp (rounded-sm) and colors to map to the strict industrial Swiss archetype.
Build a robust sidebar navigation layout (EventGudang) with a sticky header containing user avatar, page title, and search.
Implement the Dashboard with modular KPI cards arranged in a dense grid (Bento/High Density pattern).
For the inventory table, use Shadcn Table. Incorporate the provided thumbnail images and use the brand_palette for colored dots/chips.
Implement the 11-color palette picker in Master Data -> Brands.
Use react-qr-code or similar for the Surat Jalan detail view.
For PDF printing, setup a printable area using CSS media queries (@media print) or react-to-print.
Add 'data-testid' to ALL interactive elements (forms, buttons, inputs, links).
Ensure all copy is in Indonesian (e.g., Jenis Barang, Tersedia, Keluar, Rusak, Hilang, Penerimaan, Surat Jalan).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Break the mold: use industrial precision, high-contrast borders, and clear typographic hierarchy.
DO NOT use generic centered layouts. Left-align data and forms for readability.
NEVER use 'transition: all'. Use specific CSS transitions.
DO NOT use transparent backgrounds on overlays/dropdowns. Ensure a solid background.
Use 2-3x more spacing for structural layout between sections, but keep data tables and dashboards dense and scannable.
Use sonner for toasts at top-right.
Ensure strict adherence to the provided colors and fonts. Do not invent new shades.
Do not use AI assistant Emoji characters (like 🤖, 💡, etc).
